results.description:
Their amor was never meant to be real—until their undeniable attraction made it impossible to fake.

Aspiring publicist Luna Santos' reputation was perfectly curated, impeccable... until she was falsely accused of cheating. After drowning in a social media storm with a shattered name, her publicist presents the ultimate redemption: a fake relationship with reggaeton's bad boy superstar, Rio Castillo. The only problem? They've despised each other ever since their spark-filled first meeting, when Luna shot down his suave advances, convinced he was a player.

But Rio needs this showmance to reclaim his spot at the top, fill stadiums, dominate the charts, and make las nenas shake their hips. For his comeback—and her redemption—Luna and Rio are forced to play the perfect couple, even as their fiery chemistry simmers beneath the surface.

As they navigate the relationship script, what begins as raw animosity morphs into something auténtico, undeniably passionate, and utterly consuming. But in the ruthless world of fame, where personal demons and fierce rivals lurk, can their unexpected love song withstand the pulse-pounding ritmo of the spotlight?

Wishing for La Luna is a contemporary enemies-to-lovers Latinx romance part of the sexy, pulsating Ritmo y Deseo series, set in the Ficha Mundial universe. Lose yourself in this irresistible journey of love, music, unfiltered sensuality, and soul-deep connection—buy it today. It contains a cliffhanger.
